title: Corrigendum to the Notification for Auxiliary Nurse Midwife / Village Health Nurse.

source.name: Medical Services Recruitment Board (MRB), Tamil Nadu

text:
KEY LINES:
Notification No.10/MRB/2023 Dated:31.10.2023.
No.10/MRB/2023 dated:11.10.2023, the following instructions are issued:
In the Notification No.10/ MRB / 2023 dated:11.10.2023, the last
date for online application was fixed as 31.10.2023. As per
dated:30.10.2023 and Government Letter No:5960029/L1/2023-1,
Dated:31.10.2023, the last date for receipt of on-line application is
hereby extended up to 15.11.2023. Consequently the last date for
online Registration and online payment will be 15.11.2023.

FULL TEXT:
GOVERNMENT OF TAMIL NADU
MEDICAL SERVICES RECRUITMENT BOARD (MRB)
7thFloor, DMS Building, 359, Anna Salai,
Teynampet, Chennai-06. Website: www.mrb.tn.gov.in
Email: mrb.tn.nic@gmail.com Phone no: 044-24355757
Notification No.10/MRB/2023 Dated:31.10.2023.
CORRIGENDUM
In partial modification of the detailed Notification
No.10/MRB/2023 dated:11.10.2023, the following instructions are issued:
In the Notification No.10/ MRB / 2023 dated:11.10.2023, the last
date for online application was fixed as 31.10.2023. As per
directions of the Hon’ble High Court of Madras at Madurai Bench in
W.P.(MD)No.25982 of 2023 and W.M.P.(MD) No.22353 of 2023,
dated:30.10.2023 and Government Letter No:5960029/L1/2023-1,
Dated:31.10.2023, the last date for receipt of on-line application is
hereby extended up to 15.11.2023. Consequently the last date for
online Registration and online payment will be 15.11.2023.
MEMBER SECRETARY
